name: Resident Evil Vita
author: KiddRwxSsj
description:
Port of the 1997 PC version of Resident Evil to the PS Vita, built from the community decompilation of the game. It keeps the original game code and adds a Vita platform layer using vitaGL, SceAudio, ffmpeg and SceAvPlayer.
It supports the USA PC release and the Japanese MediaKite release, and adds a 60 FPS mode, an in-game settings panel, quick saves, PC save compatibility and a mod manager for HD background packs, movie packs and audio mods. No game files are included.
